'''Marco Durante''' (born in 1965 in [[Naples, Italy]]) is an Italian physicist known for his contributions to [[radiation biophysics]], [[Effects of ionizing radiation in spaceflight|space radiation]] protection, and charged [[Cancer treatment|particle cancer therapy]]. He is Director of the Biophysics Department at the [[GSI Helmholtz Centre for Heavy Ion Research|GSI Helmhotzzentrum für Schwerionenforschung]], in [[Darmstadt, Germany]], Full Professor of Physics at [[Technische Universität Darmstadt]] and part-time at the [[University of Naples Federico II]] in Italy.

== Education ==
Durante obtained a ''Laurea'' (Master’s degree) in physics from the [[University of Naples Federico II]] in 1988, and completed a PhD in physics at the same institution in 1992, performing part of the research activity at the [[Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory|Lawrence Berkeley Laboratory in Berkeley]].

== Career ==
Since 2008, Durante has been Full Professor of Physics at [[Technische Universität Darmstadt]], Germany.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Physics |first=Department of |title=Prof. PhD. Marco Durante |url=https://www.physik.tu-darmstadt.de/der_fachbereich/lehrende_physik/professor_innen_details_2394.en.jsp |access-date=2026-02-19 |website=Department of Physics – TU Darmstadt |language=en}}</ref> In 2018, he was appointed Director of the Biophysics Department at the GSI Helmholtzzentrum für Schwerionenforschung in Darmstadt.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Prestigious ERC grant for Professor Marco Durante: EU once again provides millions in funding for GSI research on tumor therapy – Investigating the FLASH effect |url=https://www.eurekalert.org/news-releases/1087804 |access-date=2026-02-19 |website=EurekAlert! |language=en}}</ref>

Previously, Durante served as Director of the Trento Institute for Fundamental Physics and Applications (TIFPA) of the [[Italian National Institute for Nuclear Physics]] (INFN) from 2015 to 2018.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Prof. Marco Durante, Ph.D. TIFPA-INFN, Director University of Trento, Department of Physics |url=https://indico.cern.ch/event/732302/attachments/1656452/2651803/Biography_-_Durante.pdf |website=indico}}</ref> He had earlier been Research Fellow at the [[Frankfurt Institute for Advanced Studies]] (FIAS) from 2009 to 2014.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Prof. Dr. Marco Durante / Helmholtz Forschungsakademie - Hessen für FAIR |url=https://hfhf-hessen.de/en/persons/atomic-and-plasma-physics/prof-dr-marco-durante/ |access-date=2026-02-19 |website=hfhf-hessen.de}}</ref>

From 2005 to 2013, he was Adjunct Professor in the Faculty of Sciences at [[Temple University]] in [[Philadelphia, United States]]. Before that, he served as Associate Professor of Physics at the [[University of Naples Federico II]] from 2000 to 2006.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Marco Durante is the Eighth Warren K. Sinclair Keynote Speaker |url=https://ncrponline.org/wp-content/themes/ncrp/PDFs/Durante-WKS.pdf |website=NCRP}}</ref>

During his early career, Durante held several international research fellowships and visiting appointments. He was Visiting Scientist at the [[National Institute of Radiological Sciences|National Institute for Radiological Sciences]] in [[Chiba Prefecture|Chiba, Japan]], from 2002 to 2003, and previously from 1997 to 1998.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Marco Durante |url=https://loop.frontiersin.org/people/187881/network |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240531135150/https://loop.frontiersin.org/people/187881/network |archive-date=2024-05-31 |access-date=2026-02-19 |website=Loop |language=en}}</ref> He was also Visiting Scientist at the University Space Research Association at the [[NASA Lyndon B. Johnson Space Center]] in [[Houston, Texas]], from 1999 to 2000, and earlier a postdoctoral researcher at the same center from 1994 to 1995.<ref name=":2">{{Cite web |title=Prestigious honor for Professor Marco Durante: Kaplan Prize for outstanding achievements in radiation research |url=https://www.gsi.de/en/start/news/details?tx_news_pi1%5Baction%5D=detail&tx_news_pi1%5Bcontroller%5D=News&tx_news_pi1%5Bnews%5D=5636&cHash=877fd90e5357e4cdea1cbdd99dc89aa8 |access-date=2026-02-19 |website=GSI}}</ref>

He served as President of the International Association for Radiation Research (IARR) and as a member of advisory committees for organizations such as the [[European Space Agency]] (ESA) and international particle accelerator research centers.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |last=OeWF |date=2014-10-25 |title=Interview with Prof. Marco Durante and his research on cosmic radiation during spaceflight |url=https://oewf.org/en/2014/10/interview-with-prof-marco-durante-and-his-research-on-cosmic-radiation-during-spaceflight/ |access-date=2026-02-19 |website=Austrian Space Forum (OeWF) |language=en-US}}</ref> He also participates on editorial boards of multiple scientific journals. He currently serves as President of the Particle Therapy Co-Operative Group.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2024-12-15 |title=Home - Particle Therapy Co-Operative Group (PTCOG) |url=https://ptcog.online/ |access-date=2026-02-25 |language=en-US}}</ref>

== Research ==
Durante’s research spans [[Radiobiology|radiation biophysics]], [[medical physics]], [[Radiotherapy|particle radiotherapy]], and [[Effects of ionizing radiation in spaceflight|space radiation]] protection.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2024-04-08 |title=Partikeltherapie gegen Krebs soll verbessert werden |url=https://www.faz.net/aktuell/rhein-main/partikeltherapie-gegen-krebs-soll-verbessert-werden-19638725.html |access-date=2026-02-25 |website=FAZ.NET |language=de}}</ref><ref name=":1">{{Cite web |last=cern |date=2025-11-07 |title=The future of particle therapy |url=https://cerncourier.com/the-future-of-particle-therapy/ |access-date=2026-02-19 |website=CERN Courier |language=en-US}}</ref> He has co-authored hundreds of peer-reviewed scientific papers on the physical and biological effects of high-energy [[charged particles]], [[biodosimetry]] methods, and optimization of particle therapy.<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Loeffler |first=Jay S. |last2=Durante |first2=Marco |date=2013 |title=Charged particle therapy—optimization, challenges and future directions |url=https://www.nature.com/articles/nrclinonc.2013.79 |journal=Nature Reviews Clinical Oncology |language=en |volume=10 |issue=7 |pages=411–424 |doi=10.1038/nrclinonc.2013.79 |issn=1759-4782|url-access=subscription }}</ref> His work has contributed to improved understanding of how [[Heavy ion fusion|heavy ions]] and [[protons]] interact with biological tissues, leading to advanced strategies in cancer particle therapy and radioprotective measures for spaceflight.<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Durante |first=Marco |last2=Flanz |first2=Jay |date=2019-06-01 |title=Charged particle beams to cure cancer: Strengths and challenges |url=https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0093775419300788 |journal=Seminars in Oncology |volume=46 |issue=3 |pages=219–225 |doi=10.1053/j.seminoncol.2019.07.007 |issn=0093-7754}}</ref>

During his post-doc at [[National Institute of Radiological Sciences|NIRS]] in Japan, Durante demonstrated that heavy charged particles such as [[Carbon monoxide|carbon ions]] result in reduced lymphocyte damage compared with conventional X-ray therapy, an effect linked to [[Dosimetry|dosimetric]] advantages of particle beams.<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Durante |first=Marco |last2=Yamada |first2=Shigeru |last3=Ando |first3=Koichi |last4=Furusawa |first4=Yoshiya |last5=Kawata |first5=Tetsuya |last6=Majima |first6=Hideyuki |last7=Nakano |first7=Takashi |last8=Tsujii |first8=Hirohiko |date=2000 |title=X-rays vs. carbon-ion tumor therapy: cytogenetic damage in lymphocytes |url=https://linkinghub.elsevier.com/retrieve/pii/S0360301600004557 |journal=International Journal of Radiation Oncology*Biology*Physics |language=en |volume=47 |issue=3 |pages=793–798 |doi=10.1016/S0360-3016(00)00455-7|url-access=subscription }}</ref> Subsequent studies have confirmed that particle therapy reduces lymphopenia compared to conventional [[Radiation therapy|X-ray treatments.]]  His Kaplan Lecture 2023 summarizes this work and its implications for combining particle therapy with immunotherapy.<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Durante |first=Marco |date=2024-05-03 |title=Kaplan lecture 2023: lymphopenia in particle therapy |url=https://www.tandfonline.com/doi/full/10.1080/09553002.2024.2324472 |journal=International Journal of Radiation Biology |language=en |volume=100 |issue=5 |pages=669–677 |doi=10.1080/09553002.2024.2324472 |issn=0955-3002|url-access=subscription }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Darmstadt |first=Technical University of |date=2025-06-17 |title=Prestigious ERC grant for Professor Marco Durante |url=https://www.tu-darmstadt.de/universitaet/aktuelles_meldungen/news_archive/news_details_en_510848.en.jsp |access-date=2026-03-03 |website=TU Darmstadt |language=en}}</ref>

=== Impact on Particle Therapy and Radiation Oncology ===
Durante is a leading voice in the field of [[particle therapy]], including research into advanced heavy ion modalities and high-dose-rate techniques such as FLASH radiotherapy.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-06-16 |title=HI-FLASH |url=https://www.gsi.de//work/forschung/biophysik/erc-grants/hi-flash |access-date=2026-02-19 |website=GSI}}</ref> In 2020 he was awarded a [[European Research Council]] (ERC) <ref>{{Cite web |date=2020-03-25 |title=BARB |url=https://www.gsi.de//work/forschung/biophysik/erc_barb |access-date=2026-02-19 |website=GSI}}</ref>Advanced Grant to study therapeutic applications of radioactive ion beams and in 2025 he got a second ERC to support innovative research on ultra-high-dose-rate heavy ion beams aimed at enhancing treatment efficacy while minimizing healthy tissue damage.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Darmstadt |first=Technical University of |date=2025-06-17 |title=Prestigious ERC grant for Professor Marco Durante |url=https://www.tu-darmstadt.de/universitaet/aktuelles_meldungen/news_archive/news_details_en_510848.en.jsp |access-date=2026-02-25 |website=TU Darmstadt |language=en}}</ref> The results of the first ERC project led to the first demonstration of tumor treatment in an animal model with high-energy radioactive ions.<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Boscolo |first=Daria |last2=Lovatti |first2=Giulio |last3=Sokol |first3=Olga |last4=Vitacchio |first4=Tamara |last5=Moglioni |first5=Martina |last6=Evangelista |first6=Francesco |last7=Haettner |first7=Emma |last8=Tinganelli |first8=Walter |last15=Thirolf |first15=Peter G. |date=October 2025 |title=Image-guided treatment of mouse tumours with radioactive ion beams |url=https://www.nature.com/articles/s41567-025-02993-8 |journal=Nature Physics |language=en |volume=21 |issue=10 |pages=1648–1656 |doi=10.1038/s41567-025-02993-8 |issn=1745-2473 |pmc=12518140 |pmid=41098546}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Freeman |first=Tami |url=https://physicsworld.com/radioactive-ion-beams-enable-simultaneous-treatment-and-imaging-in-particle-therapy/ |access-date=2026-02-19 |website=Physics World |language=en-GB}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web very active in mathematical modelling of radiation effects. The agent-based model of radiation-induced fibrosis,<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Cogno |first=Nicolò |last2=Bauer |first2=Roman |last3=Durante |first3=Marco |date=2024-02-09 |title=Mechanistic model of radiotherapy-induced lung fibrosis using coupled 3D agent-based and Monte Carlo simulations |url=https://www.nature.com/articles/s43856-024-00442-w |journal=Communications Medicine |language=en |volume=4 |issue=1 |doi=10.1038/s43856-024-00442-w  |doi-access=free|issn=2730-664X |pmc=10858213 |pmid=38336802}}</ref> developed by Durante with his Ph.D. student Niccolo’ Cogno in collaboration with the [[University of Surrey]], was selected as one of the Top 10 breakthrough in Physics 2024 according to the Institute of Physics (IOP).<ref>{{Cite web |last=Johnston |first=Hamish |date=2024-12-12 |title=Top 10 Breakthroughs of the Year in physics for 2024 revealed |url=https://physicsworld.com/top-10-breakthroughs-of-the-year-in-physics-for-2024-revealed/ |access-date=2026-02-19 |website=Physics World |language=en-GB}}</ref>

=== Space Radiation Protection ===
Beyond [[cancer therapy]], Durante’s work includes experimental and theoretical studies of [[cosmic radiation]] and shielding effectiveness, advancing risk assessment for human space exploration. He performed several experiments on space radiation shielding and radiobiology at the NASA Space Radiation Laboratory (NSRL) in the USA and has promoted the construction of the first galactic cosmic ray simulator in Europe, installed at the GSI accelerator.<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Pierobon |first=E. |last2=Lunati |first2=L. |last3=Wagner |first3=T. |last4=Durante |first4=M. |last5=Schuy |first5=C. |date=2026-02-10 |title=Hybrid active-passive galactic cosmic ray simulator: Experimental implementation and microdosimetric characterization |url=https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S2214552426000325 |journal=Life Sciences in Space Research |doi=10.1016/j.lssr.2026.02.004 |issn=2214-5524|doi-access=free |arxiv=2509.13158 }}</ref> He has collaborated on analyses of heavy ion carcinogenesis and spaceflight radiation effects, and is working in the Task Group 115 of the International Council for Radiological Protection (ICRP) to harmonize the dose limits for astronauts issued by different space agencies.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Task Group 115 Risk and Dose Assessment for Radiological Protection of Astronauts Under Committee 1 |url=https://www.icrp.org/icrp_group.asp?id=175 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260112200147/https://www.icrp.org/icrp_group.asp?id=175 |archive-date=2026-01-12 |access-date=2026-02-19 |website=www.icrp.org |language=en}}</ref>

== Publications==
Durante is co-author of over 500 papers in peer-reviewed scientific journals (Scopus h-index=72),<ref>{{Cite web |title=Durante, Marco |url=https://www.scopus.com/authid/detail.uri?authorId=7004828918 |website=Scopus}}</ref> including high-impact factor reviews on [[Nature (journal)|Nature Journal]], [[The Lancet|Lancet Oncology]], [[Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America|PNAS]], and ''[[Reviews of Modern Physics]]'', and is member of the Editorial Board of several of them.
